data: どこで 乗[の]り換[か]えですか？
Where do I transfer?
Travel
どこで (doko de) means "where," and 乗り換え (のりかえ, norikae) means "transfer."
バスを 乗[の]り換[か]えなければいけませんか？
Do I have to transfer buses?
Travel
バス (basu) means "bus." 乗り換え (のりかえ, norikae) means "transfer." なければいけません (nakereba ikemasen) is the negative obligation form, meaning "must." か (ka) turns it into a question.
